growth_signal.value: Press reports rapid expansion despite local backlash.

entry.idea: Many German cafes are slow and pricey; LAP Coffee runs fast grab-and-go coffee shops with a simple menu.
entry.lesson: Take a slow local habit, make it fast and standard, and scale it like a chain.
entry.name: LAP Coffee

growth.basis: substitute: press coverage of fast expansion
growth.reason: Several outlets report fast expansion, but no numbers were found.

market.reason: Coffee is a real market, but this is mainly one country so far.

tech.reason: It is a shop concept with little unique technology.

sources.title: Germany's fast-growing chain LAP Coffee puts pressure on established local cafes
Berlin's LAP Coffee expands despite backlash in Germany

entry.twist: It grows like a chain with venture money, which has caused a backlash from local cafes in Berlin.
entry.who_pays: Coffee drinkers pay for each drink in the shops.
entry.why_now: Investors are backing quick-service coffee as people want cheap, fast specialty coffee.
